title: Terms of Software Maintenance, Security Patching and Database Protection under the Building Automation Service Plans
content:
# Terms of Software Maintenance, Security Patching and Database Protection under the Building Automation Service Plans

**Term 1 — Security patches.** Security patches published by the controls manufacturer are applied to controllers covered by a Building Automation Service Plan inside the tier's patch period, counted in calendar days from the day the patch was published, at no charge at every tier.

**Term 2 — Version updates and upgrades.** Minor version updates are applied at no charge only where the tier includes them, and a major version upgrade is carried out at no labor charge only where the tier includes major upgrades. The former continuation of this term, "elsewhere the upgrade is quoted, with the tier's upgrade labor discount applied, and the manufacturer's licence cost is passed through unchanged", is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis on which upgrade labor a plan does not include is quoted.

**Term 3 — Software assurance.** Software assurance, where the tier carries it, keeps the site's licence current with the manufacturer and lapses with the plan, so a plan that is cancelled leaves the licence frozen at its last covered version.

**Term 4 — Backup and restore.** A database backup is taken at the tier's frequency and kept for the tier's retention period, and a restore is carried out at no charge only where the tier includes restore service.

The per-tier values these terms turn on — the patch period in days, whether minor updates and major upgrades are included, the upgrade labor discount, the backup frequency and the retention months — are those of the tier schedules.

## Patch period boundary (hypothetical)

Under a tier with a patch period of 45 calendar days, a patch published on day 0 is applied within the period if applied on any day up to and including day 45 counted in calendar days from the day it was published; application on day 46 falls outside the period.

## Charge table for updates

| Work | Charge |
|---|---|
| Security patch, any tier | none |
| Minor version update, tier includes minor updates | none |
| Major version upgrade, tier includes major upgrades | no labor charge |
| Restore from backup, tier includes restore service | none |

superseded_clauses: elsewhere the upgrade is quoted, with the tier's upgrade labor discount applied, and the manufacturer's licence cost is passed through unchanged
